content:
Center-to-center spacing = picture width + gap:
\[
420+1040=1460\text{ mm}
\]

Centers of the four pictures from the left wall:
\[
210,\quad 210+1460=1670,\quad 1670+1460=3130,\quad 4590
\]

The two remaining pictures have centers at \(1670\) mm and \(3130\) mm from the left wall.

The wall center is:
\[
2400\text{ mm}
\]

Distance from each remaining picture center to the wall center:
\[
|1670-2400|=730,\qquad |3130-2400|=730
\]

\[
\boxed{730}
\]
